summary: This tutorial covers configuring email settings on Linux using Thunderbird, specifically for Gmail and Yahoo accounts. It explains how to add folders, move messages between folders, and set up advanced filters. For Gmail, you launch Thunderbird, select your Gmail account, right-click on the inbox, and choose "New Folder" to create a new folder like "Important Mails." You can then drag and drop messages into this folder. Advanced filtering allows you to search for specific messages based on criteria like subject or sender. For Yahoo, you configure it similarly but note that Yahoo already supports POP by default. The tutorial also demonstrates setting up filters to automatically move messages to specific folders based on certain conditions, such as moving emails with a specific subject to the "Important Mails" folder.
